build_commands.value: 三仓库顺序构建：hucx(./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-opt --prefix=... --enable-mt --disable-numa --with-pic --enable-inc --without-java CC=gcc CXX=g++ FC=gfortran && make -j N && make install) → xucg(cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=... -DUCG_BUILD_WITH_UCX=... && make -j N && make install) → hmpi(./autogen.pl && ./configure --prefix=... --with-platform=contrib/platform/mellanox/optimized --enable-mpi1-compatibility --with-ucx=... --with-ucg=... --with-pic CC=gcc CXX=g++ FC=gfortran && make -j N && make install)
